ValidationRule.description: If the Task is assigned to the Principal Review Queue, the user changing the status to 'Approved' or 'Complete' must be a member of the Principal Review Queue.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Completed"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Approved") ), AND( NOT ( $Permission.Principal_Approver_Task_Approval ), Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'Principal_Review') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This task is Assigned to the Principal Review Queue. You can only set the Task status to 'Approved' or 'Complete' if you are a member of the Principal Review Queue.
